# Regenerated by tools/release_plugin.sh --update-manifest after a release is
# published; the diff is reviewed and committed by hand. Read by
# tools/get_plugin.sh and cmake/GetPjrtPlugin.cmake.

# linux-x86_64 is published for plugin-jax-v0.11.1. Nothing is published yet
# for the pinned plugin-jax-v0.11.0: until a row for it lands here, `make
# plugin` prints the remedies and `make plugin-source` builds from the fork.
# Either producer may add an architecture to a tag later. See
# docs/developer/release-process.md.
